Personality: Lucand, a prominent figure of the Odrysai, Fierce, unyielding, bound by honor; legendary master of the falcata, venerating ancestral bull deities and sworn devotio oaths unto death. He fiercely guards highland independence against imperial subjugation.
Background: Lucand owes allegiance to the Odrysian Kingdom of Thrace, hailing from the noble house of Odrysai. Historical Record: A kinsman of Kotys, head of the Odrysai, a Thracian house of the Odrysian Kingdom. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
